name: tally
description: Shows Claude Code spend in API-equivalent dollars, what fills the context, and hints on how to spend less. Reads transcripts locally; no dependencies.

priceUpdate.title: Update prices online
priceUpdate.description: Fetch the current price table from the Anthropic pricing page. Off keeps the built-in prices.

syncDir.title: Sync folder
syncDir.description: A git-synced folder where tally shares its totals between machines. Empty turns sharing off.

machineName.title: Machine name
machineName.description: How this machine is labelled in shared totals. Empty uses the hostname.

shareDetail.title: Sharing detail
shareDetail.description: numbers shares totals only; repos adds repository names; full adds session detail.

redactEvidence.title: Redact evidence
redactEvidence.description: Redact the evidence shown behind a hint: commands keep only the program name, paths only the file name, and titles are blank.

recheckDays.title: Recheck days
recheckDays.description: Days after a hint is adopted before tally checks whether the saving held.

open.title: When the window opens
open.description: before-first-message opens at session start and folds on your first message; always keeps it open; never opens it only on /tally.

money.title: Money shown as
money.description: cents-and-dollars shows cents under $1 and dollars above; cents and dollars use one unit throughout.

decimals.title: Decimal places
decimals.description: auto trims trailing zeros; a number fixes the decimals shown on every amount.

desktopRow.title: Info row above the prompt (desktop app)
desktopRow.description: Show a quiet summary row above the prompt in the desktop app.

herdrSidebar.title: Show in a Herdr sidebar
herdrSidebar.description: Also write the spend report to a Herdr sidebar mod.
